title: "Road accidents in France, 2005-2025"
subtitle: "Who gets seriously hurt, where and why"
author: "Mouataz Bounit"
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: false
---

An end-to-end analysis of the 1.34 million injury accidents recorded by the French police between 2005
and 2025, from the raw official files to maps, statistical models and machine learning.

- **[Interactive dashboard](site/dashboard.html)**: filter by years, department and mode of transport;
  maps of deaths per inhabitant and per accident; model results.
- **[Full report](site/report.html)**: data engineering, exploratory analysis, geography, logistic
  regression, machine learning, evaluation and discussion.
- **[Interactive map of 2025 fatal accidents](figures/04_geography/interactive_map.html)**.

Data: ONISR road injury accident databases (BAAC) on data.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte 2.0; populations INSEE.
